# VectraSyn

> Affordable, fast-turnaround digital services for small businesses: websites, apps, automation, and logo/branding. English-language site. Pricing available in INR (default), USD and AED.

## Site structure

- / — Home: overview of the four core services, pricing preview, proof-of-work preview, contact CTA.
- /pricing — Full service menu with list price and final price (50% off) in INR, USD or AED.
- /proof-of-work — Case study grid. All slots are placeholders marked "Case Study Coming Soon".
- /about — Company story, how we work (Discover, Build, Launch, Support), FAQ.
- /contact — Contact form, address placeholder, map placeholder, social icons.

## Core services

- Websites — fast, mobile-friendly business websites.
- Apps — focused mobile or web apps.
- Automation — simple pipelines connecting business tools.
- Logo & Branding — original logo and brand files.

## Pricing (list price -> final price, 50% off)

- Website Only: INR 36,000 -> 18,000 | USD 700 -> 350 | AED 3,000 -> 1,500
- Simple Pipeline: INR 10,000 -> 5,000 | USD 200 -> 100 | AED 800 -> 400
- Logo Design: INR 10,000 -> 5,000 | USD 200 -> 100 | AED 800 -> 400
- GBP Setup: INR 12,000 -> 6,000 | USD 200 -> 100 | AED 800 -> 400
- App Only: INR 70,000 -> 35,000 | USD 1,200 -> 600 | AED 5,000 -> 2,500
- Bundle 1: INR 50,000 -> 25,000 | USD 900 -> 450 | AED 3,800 -> 1,900
- Bundle 2: INR 100,000 -> 50,000 | USD 1,800 -> 900 | AED 7,500 -> 3,750
- Monthly Maintenance: INR 16,000 -> 8,000/mo | USD 300 -> 150/mo | AED 1,200 -> 600/mo
